title: The Return of Darkness and Evil

structure.name: Verse
lyrics:
[Willian] A sorcery written in blood
Whispered by a witch in the dawn
Give all the hell 'cause you've still got the strength
To start up the Black Metal storm

[Willian] The darkness possessing, you thought that you could
The blood starts to freeze in your veins
Your mindset is high and it's all to be real
You're feeling there's no longer strength

structure.name: Pre-Chorus
lyrics:
[Willian] I ride the flame
You take the pain
I'll raise the dead
Black Metal night is here again

[Willian] Fire and flame
You take the pain
I'll raise the dead
Black Metal night is here again

structure.name: Chorus
lyrics:
[Willian] It's the return of darkness and evil (darkness and evil)
It's the return of fire and flame
It's the return of my master Satan (my master Satan)
It's the return of soul-burning pain

structure.name: Verse
lyrics:
[Lucas] Sacrifice a virgin to the flames of burning hell
Black witch of beauty, recite the words of spell
Gather masses, run in circles, scream for mercy, burning flame
Living hard, this is the master, let 'em feel the blood and pain

[Lucas] *They're superior and angels of one*
*His angels of goodness have died*
The demon's despising the virgin's cries
To the heavens of dust in the night
